title: Welder Invoice Template
subtitle: An invoice pre-filled for welding services — MIG and TIG labor, materials, mobilization, repairs and safety fees. Download as Excel (auto-calculating), Word, or PDF.
taxHint: Look up your state's sales tax rate
paymentTerms: Net 10 — payment due within 10 days. Workmanship guaranteed for 90 days on welded joints.
notes: Thank you for your business. Welding performed per AWS D1.1/D1.2 standards where applicable.
features: Auto-calculating tax formulas in Excel (just enter your state rate)
Pre-filled welding line items: MIG/TIG labor, materials, mobilization, repairs
90-day workmanship guarantee printed on the invoice
Separate labor and materials lines make cost breakdown transparent

faqs.q: What should I include on a welder invoice?
faqs.a: At minimum: your business name, the client and job site, a dated line-item list (labor by type, materials, mobilization), tax, and a total due. Note any weld standard used and your workmanship guarantee.

faqs.q: Is this template free to use?
faqs.a: Yes. All three formats (PDF, Word, Excel) are free to download with no email required.

faqs.q: Does the Excel version calculate tax automatically?
faqs.a: Yes. Enter your quantity and rate per line, and the subtotal, tax and total update automatically. Leave the tax rate blank if you are not required to charge sales tax.

faqs.q: Is this legal or tax advice?
faqs.a: No. Templates are for informational purposes only. Requirements vary by state — verify with your licensing authority and a CPA or attorney before use.
